# Photo credits

- `pug.jpg`: "Pug in a warm sweater (Unsplash)", Wikimedia Commons, CC0. Resized to 640 px.
- `frenchie.jpg`: "French Bulldog Puppy (Unsplash)", Wikimedia Commons, CC0. Resized to 640 px.
- `jfk.wav`: 11 s from John F. Kennedy's inaugural address (1961), a US government work in the public domain; the 16 kHz sample distributed with whisper.cpp.
- `sample.rar` and `sample.7z`: `test_read_format_rar.rar` and `test_read_format_7zip_lzma2.7z` from libarchive's own test suite (https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive, BSD-2-Clause), decoded from their `.uu` files.
- `plain.zip`, `locked.zip` (password `tide-pool`) and `bundle.tar.gz`: made for these tests with Info-ZIP and tar.
- `ocr-scene.jpg` and `ocr-texture.jpg`: generated by `make-ocr-scenes.py` for the image-to-text tests (synthetic clutter, no third-party material).
- `tone-16k-mono.mp4`: 4 s test pattern with a 440 Hz tone (H.264 and mono 16 kHz AAC), generated for the video encoder tests; no third-party material.
- `pixel-aspect-99-100.mp4`: 2 s of a still photo scaled to 640x360 (H.264, no sound) with a pixel aspect ratio of 99:100, so it shows as 640x364. For the video encoder tests; made from `face.jpg`, no third-party material.
- `speech.mov`: the first 11 s of `jfk.wav` under a generated test pattern, in a QuickTime .mov with AAC sound like an iPhone camera file, for the caption tests; no third-party material beyond `jfk.wav`.
- `iphone-portrait.mov` and `iphone-hevc.mov`: 4 s test pattern (1280x720, turned 90 degrees by the file so it shows upright as 720x1280, like an iPhone held upright) with a 440 Hz tone, 44.1 kHz stereo AAC, in a QuickTime .mov: H.264 and HEVC. For the Resize video tests; no third-party material.
- `layered.psd` and `transparent.psd`: 160x120 Photoshop documents written by `make-psd.mjs` with ag-psd (MIT) for the PSD pair-page tests; generated shapes and flat colours, no third-party material.
- `cmyk.psd`: 16x16 CMYK Photoshop document (a cyan-to-magenta gradient) generated with ImageMagick (`magick -size 16x16 gradient:cyan-magenta -colorspace CMYK -depth 8 -compress none cmyk.psd`) for the PSD pair-page test that CMYK files are declined; no third-party material.
- `iphone-portrait-person.mov`: 1.5 s of `face.jpg` drifting right in front of a generated door, bar and towel stripes, stored as 1280x720 H.264 and turned 90 degrees by the file so it shows upright as 720x1280. Made by `make-rotated-person.py` (Pillow and ffmpeg, fixture tooling only) for the Video background remover tests; no third-party material beyond `face.jpg`.
- `uhd-flat.mp4`: 1 s of a flat blue colour at 3840x2160 (H.264, no sound), generated with ffmpeg's `color` source for the phone big-clip note test; no third-party material.
- `enc-content.7z`, `enc-header.7z`, `enc-rar4.rar`, `enc-rar4-header.rar`, `enc-rar5.rar`, `enc-rar5-header.rar`: the same three small files (`hello.txt`, `docs/note.txt`, `docs/data.bin`, a generated byte pattern) packed with the password `tide-pool` by 7-Zip 24 (`7zz a -ptide-pool`, with `-mhe=on` for the header one) and WinRAR's command line (`rar a -r -ptide-pool -ma4|-ma5`, with `-hp` for encrypted file names), for the Archive extractor password tests; no third-party material.
- `xvid-mp3.avi`, `mjpeg-pcm.avi`, `wmv2.avi`, `h264-mp3.avi` and `avi-reference.json`: 5 s of ffmpeg's `testsrc` test pattern (320x240, 10 fps) with a 440 Hz tone, made by `make-avi.sh` for the AVI to MP4 tests: Xvid-tagged MPEG-4 with MP3, Motion JPEG with PCM, and WMV2 and H.264 (codecs the page does not decode, for the named-error test). The JSON holds reference colours read from the AVI by native ffmpeg; no third-party material.
- `tone-v1.wma`, `tone-v2.wma` and `wmapro-stand-in.wma`: 6 s of a 440 Hz sine tone generated with ffmpeg's `sine` source and written as WMA 1 and WMA 2 (the stand-in is the WMA 2 file with its format tag changed to WMA Pro, for the refusal path), made by `make-wma.sh` for the WMA to MP3 tests; no third-party material.
- `h264-aac.flv`, `h264-mp3.flv`, `h264-mp3-22k.flv`, `spark-mp3.flv`, `vp6-mp3.flv`: 5 s of ffmpeg's `testsrc` test pattern (320x240, 10 fps) with a 440 Hz tone, made by `make-flv.sh` for the FLV to MP4 tests: H.264 with AAC or MP3 sound, and Sorenson Spark with MP3. `vp6-mp3.flv` is the Spark file with its video tags relabelled VP6 (ffmpeg has no VP6 encoder) to test the refusal. No third-party material.
- `tiny.heic` and `tiny.webp`: a 96 x 64 colour gradient made for the any-image landing tests (no third-party material).
- `flat-blue-tone.mp4` and `logo-red.png`: 3 s of a flat blue (#305fa8) at 320x240, 15 fps (H.264, BT.709, with a 440 Hz mono AAC tone), and a 96x48 solid red logo, both generated with ffmpeg and Pillow for the Add watermark to video tests; no third-party material.
